# Cobblemere Lido - visitor information

Water temperature
The lap pool is kept at 27.5 degrees through the year. The shallow teaching pool runs a degree or two warmer, and the plunge pool is unheated.

Opening times
Lanes are bookable from 06:30 to 21:00. The cafe closes at 20:00.

# Finding us

Cobblemere Lido sits on the north bank, ten minutes on foot from Millstone Lane tram stop. Cycle racks are at the main gate; the car park is pay and display.
